description: Prices Managed Inference on Google Cloud (Model A): GPU clusters and vLLM endpoints that run in the client's own GCP project. Google bills compute to the client at list price; Wells Software Consulting LLC bills a flat management retainer per node ($250 L4, $800 A100 80GB, $2,500 H100). For a model, peak requests per second, token split and commitment tier it returns every node shape with GCP compute, retainer and total per month, plus node counts with N+1 once throughput baselines are published (sizing_ready).

tier.description: GCP pricing tier. cud_3y also notes DWS calendar block prices for H100. Default on_demand
